correctness.rationale: The quotient equations are obtained from the invariant coordinates of the involution. Exact symbolic projective checks show that the cubic Y and branch complete intersection C are smooth. The residual order-three fixed locus is exactly three reduced points, and the tangent weights are (1,2), so the quotient germs are A2. The finite quotient has K_Y=pi^*K_Z in codimension one, giving K_Z^2=1 and ampleness of -K_Z. Riemann-Hurwitz gives genus one for C/<tau>. The included verifier replays these algebraic checks exactly.
